description: This file defines a PHP class ScssHelper within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Corporate Branding plugin. The class provides utility methods to manipulate SCSS colors such as darkening, lightening, converting to rgba, and validating colors.

classes.name: ScssHelper
classes.description: A helper class for processing and manipulating SCSS color variables using the ScssPhp compiler library.

methods.name: getNewCompiler
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SCSS compiler with compressed output style.

methods.name: darken
methods.description: Darkens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS darken function.

methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lightens a given color by a specified amount using SCSS lighten function.

methods.name: rgba
methods.description: Converts a color to its rgba representation with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: isValidColor
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid color recognized by the compiler.
